milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate close enough to the sweet berry bush cluster and face it to visually identify it. Target is the center of the 6-bush cluster at spawn-relative [4, 0, 4]. max_distance=8 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the bushes.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate to the hut and get close enough to the note block inside to visually identify it. Target is the note block at spawn-relative [8, 0, 8]. max_distance=5 requires the player to be at or inside the hut doorway (the hut entrance is at z=6, note block at z=8), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the note block.
